payload.friendly_name: Charter example packs replace the open-packs corpus
payload.purpose_context: Charter tests read pinned open-packs content while open-packs authors against charter's schemas; every breaking contract change leaves one side red. ADR-0070 (accepted) moves the proof onto example packs charter owns and lets open-packs validate against a pinned charter release. Done on the PR #474 branch so that PR merges green.
payload.purpose_tldr: Charter's tests prove the contract on charter-owned example packs, so a contract change can reach green without waiting for open-packs.

options: Follow-up issue in open-packs (charter side only here)
Build it here as a second PR in open-packs
payload.question: ADR-0070 decision 3 needs a validation job in spec-kitty-open-packs CI. This mission runs on the charter PR #474 branch. Should the open-packs job be built in this mission (a second PR in open-packs), or filed as a follow-up issue there?
